description: Social media scheduling API for publishing, scheduling and managing posts across connected channels.

api.description: Read one channel's analytics rows for a period

fields.description: The integration id to read analytics for.
How many days to look back, such as `7`, `30` or `90`.

fields.type: { label?: string | null, percentageChange?: number | null, data?: { total?: string | number | null, date?: string | null }[] | null }[]

api.description: Read a channel's next free posting slot

fields.description: The integration id whose posting schedule to read.
The next free slot, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

api.description: Confirm the API key is valid and the workspace is reachable

fields.description: True when the key is valid and the workspace is reachable.

api.description: List the connected channels, optionally narrowed to one customer group

fields.description: Only channels assigned to this customer (group) id.

fields.type: { id?: string | null, name?: string | null, identifier?: string | null, picture?: string | null, disabled?: boolean | null, profile?: string | null, customer?: { id?: string | null, name?: string | null } | null }[]

api.description: Page through the organization's media library, optionally filtered by file name

fields.description: Page number, starting at 1. The library returns 18 files per page.
Case-insensitive filter on the original file name.
The total number of pages.

fields.type: { id?: string | null, name?: string | null, originalName?: string | null, path?: string | null, thumbnail?: string | null, alt?: string | null, createdAt?: string | null }[]

api.description: Copy a file from a public URL into the media library, for use as a post attachment

fields.description: A public http(s) URL Postiz downloads the file from.
Resize and re-encode the file to the platforms' limits after the upload. Runs in the background; the result's `status` is `processing` until it is done.
The uploaded media id.
The hosted URL of the file.
`processing` while `adjust` runs, otherwise `ready`.

api.description: Page through the organization notifications, newest first

fields.description: Page number, starting at 0. The API returns 100 notifications per page.

fields.type: { id?: string | null, content?: string | null, link?: string | null, createdAt?: string | null }[]

fields.description: Notifications across all pages.
This page, starting at 0.
True when another page exists.

api.description: Move a post between draft and scheduled. Scheduling queues it to publish at its stored date to every channel it targets

fields.description: The post id to move.
`draft` pulls the post back to a draft, and `schedule` returns it to the queue.
The new state, `DRAFT` or `QUEUE`.

api.description: Create a post as a draft, scheduled, or published immediately. A schedule or an immediate post goes out to every listed channel and cannot be recalled by this plugin once published

fields.description: `draft` saves without publishing, `schedule` queues for `date`, and `now` publishes as soon as Postiz takes it.
When to publish, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.
Whether Postiz shortens the links in the post.
Tags to attach to the post.

fields.type: { integration: { id: string }, value: { content: string, image?: { id: string, path: string, thumbnailTimestamp?: number }[], id?: string }[], group?: string, settings?: { __type?: string | null } }[]
fields.description: The per-integration posts. Required unless `type` is `draft`.
Minutes between the parts of a thread.

fields.type: { postId?: string | null, integration?: string | null }[]

api.description: Delete a post, which also deletes every post in its group. A published post stays live on the platform

fields.description: The post id. Deleting one removes every post in its group.
The id that was deleted.

api.description: List posts in a date window with their state, release URL and any platform error

fields.description: Inclusive start of the window, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
Inclusive end of the window, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
Only posts for this customer (group) id.

fields.type: { id?: string | null, content?: string | null, settings?: { __type?: string | null } | null, publishDate?: string | null, releaseURL?: string | null, state?: string | null, error?: string | null, integration?: { id?: string | null, providerIdentifier?: string | null, name?: string | null, picture?: string | null } | null }[]
